lesson: Both shorts failed due to aggressive entry into oversold conditions, ignoring Wyckoffian spring potential at support levels despite bearish structural alignment. The system is correctly identifying the trend but failing to account for mean reversion liquidity sweeps before continuation.
adjustment: Require a confirmed bearish retest of the previous swing low (SMC break of structure) before entering, rather than shorting directly into support levels.
methodology_flag: Trust Wyckoff accumulation signals MORE when sentiment is at extreme fear.
